hero.title: Gnars is a headless brand run by its shredders

tv.empty: No channels on air right now.

stake.title: Pick your rider. Your deposit stays yours.
stake.body: Deposit into a rider's sponsorship vault. Only the yield is shared — you keep 50%, the rider gets 25%, the Gnars treasury gets 25%. Withdraw the principal whenever you want.
stake.whyBody: Sponsorships used to mean one brand writing one check. Now anyone can co-sponsor a rider — deposit, keep your principal, and let the yield do the giving.

bounties.title: Challenges
bounties.body: Gnars Bounties are challenges from the community: pay athletes in ETH to land the tricks, runs, and stunts the community wants to see filmed.
bounties.flow: create or select a bounty → fund it → execute and submit work → get verified → paid onchain
bounties.whyBody: No committee decides what's worth filming. Anyone can post a challenge and fund it — the same open pattern that put a rail in 9 countries.

back.noDescription: No brief written for this bounty.

rails.title: {rails} rails. {countries} countries. One big crew
rails.body: A global network of community skate infrastructure — funded by proposals, installed by locals, free forever. Spin the globe or pick a spot to see the proposal that built it.
rails.hint: Drag to spin · click a spot
rails.whyBody: Every pin is a proposal that passed and a crew that showed up. CC0 means anyone can build the next one — no license, no permission needed.

swap.title: Need some ETH?
swap.body: With the Support Gnars treasury box ticked, 0.5% of every trade routes straight to the Gnars Collective Treasury — already behind 15 skatable sculptures around the world, ambassador sponsorships, and infrastructure for a network of shredders from across the planet.

loop.swap: of every swap to the treasury
loop.yield: of stake yield to the treasury

swap.whyBody: Auctions, swaps and yield all feed one treasury. Every rider votes on where it goes next — that's the whole DAO, in one card.

gov.title: Join the crew
gov.auctionFootnote: New Gnars are auctioned continuously onchain. Anyone can bid; the winner mints the Gnar and funds flow to the DAO treasury to back proposals.
